name: Todays Checkouts
query:
select
	b.name as "Booking:Link/Resort Booking:150",
	b.guest as "Guest:Link/Guest:150",
	b.status as "Status::100",
	b.check_out as "Check-out:Date:100",
	b.balance_due as "Balance Due:Currency:120"
from `tabResort Booking` b
where b.check_out = CURDATE()
	and b.status = 'Checked-in'
order by b.guest
